subject: Contract timeline and QBR slot allocation — Renewal & Capacity Review
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Apr 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Contract timeline and QBR slot allocation — Renewal & Capacity Review

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Per our notes, I wanted to kick off a quick timeline and coordination thread so we can lock the QBR slot, confirm headcount/capacity needs, and align on next steps for the contract. High-level items: 

- Objective: finalize renewal term, confirm committed capacity (monthly token throughput + burst allowances), and sign the updated MSA amendment.
- Suggested internal timeline:
  * Week of Apr 15: mutual review of redlines and PO timing
  * Apr 17–19: joint QBR to review capacity forecasts, runbook, and rollout windows
  * Apr 22–26: finalize pricing and route to procurement/legal for signature
- Immediate asks for CloudWave: please confirm availability for a 60-minute QBR on either Apr 17 (10:00–11:00 PT) or Apr 18 (11:00–12:00 PT).
- Stakeholders we plan to invite from Redwood: myself (AM), Kimberly Park (Legal/Proc escalation), Marissa Cole (Customer Success — onboarding plan). If you want others invited from CloudWave, please call them out.

Attachments included: proposed redline of the MSA, a capacity worksheet with our recommended headroom for the next 12 months, and a draft QBR agenda.

[Attachment: CloudWave_MSA_Redline.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Capacity_Worksheet_CloudWave.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: QBR_Agenda_v1.docx (Doc)]

If those two QBR windows don't work, share two alternatives and we'll try to be flexible. Once you confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite and surface any open pricing questions for Marissa/Kimberly.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference — Making inference predictable and economical for product teams.

Ben —

Appreciate the clear plan. Apr 17 at 10:00 PT works best for our execs (Elena + procurement lead). We do have one ask up front: can you confirm whether the proposed redline changes the monthly commitment floor (we saw a note about a "staggered uplift" in the worksheet)? Procurement would like clarity before the QBR so they can prepare the PO.

Also looping in our procurement mailbox so they start the vendor intake.

Thanks — looking forward to the agenda.

Elena Ruiz

Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract timeline and QBR slot allocation — Renewal & Capacity Review

Elena / Procurement team —

Great, thanks for confirming Apr 17 at 10:00 PT. To answer the procurement question: the redline includes an optional staircase uplift (section 3.2a) — it does not change the current base monthly commitment unless CloudWave chooses the stepped uplift path. I've added inline comments in the redline PDF to make that explicit (see pages 2–3).

Next steps on our side: Kimberly will review the redline for any legal risk flags; Marissa will prepare the runway plan for the QBR (onboarding milestones + runbook); I'll add a short pricing appendix to clarify how burst usage is billed outside committed throughput.

I'll send the calendar invite in a minute and include a shared Drive folder with the final artifacts.

Calendar invite: Apr 17, 2029 10:00–11:00 PT — QBR: Renewal & Capacity Review (CloudWave / Redwood)
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1example-cloudwave-renewal

Ben

[Attachment: Pricing_Appendix_Redwood.pdf (PDF)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract timeline and QBR slot allocation — Renewal & Capacity Review

Ben — quick internal note before the QBR.

- I reviewed the MSA redline; main negotiation points to be prepared for: liability cap language (section 7), data residency exception, and the staircase uplift opt-in mechanics. I added comments in the PDF and flagged one suggested deletion that reduces our operational flexibility — will share redline summary in the meeting.
- Recommend we surface a short two-slide appendix for the QBR that outlines: 1) what triggers an uplift, 2) billing example for burst vs committed, 3) rollback/fallback policy if usage exceeds thresholds. Marissa — can you draft that with the onboarding milestones?
- Internal pre-QBR: I'd like a 20-min blocker with AM + CS tomorrow Apr 16 at 3:30 PT to align on messaging. If you can't make it I'll record notes.

KM
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
